capabilities: Create handwriting notes as *.ink.md markdown files that open in a pen-first canvas view
Draw with pressure-sensitive pen, highlighter, eraser, and select tools, including stylus buttons and paper guides
Transcribe handwriting into a text layer that core search, graph, backlinks, and Quick Switcher index
Embed sketches inline via ![[embeds]] or ```inkedmark fenced blocks with searchable captions
Run handwriting recognition through manual, cloud AI, or experimental on-device providers
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Also installable via BRAT (pcrausaz/obsidian-inkedmark). On iPad, iPadOS Scribble must be turned off or strokes drop. Cloud recognition sends rendered ink images to the chosen vendor; the manual provider works fully offline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to write by hand inside notes, and handwritten content is otherwise invisible to search, graph, and backlinks.

relations.evidence: The OpenRouter vendor lets you try any vision model on the market
any self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, LocalAI)
an offline TrOCR model transcribes the ink line-by-line, entirely on your machine

requires.name: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, or custom endpoint key

summary: Handwriting plugin that stores pressure-sensitive ink notes as markdown files, with a searchable transcription layer, inline sketches, and Apple Pencil support.
